scripts.build:web:examples: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/web-examples run build
scripts.check: npm run release:check && cargo test --all && npm run check:wasm && npm run check:web && npm run test:web && npm run check:web:examples
scripts.check:wasm: RUSTC="$(rustup which rustc)" cargo check -p wvst-web-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.check:web:examples: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/web-examples run check
scripts.example:web:effect: npm run build:web:examples && npm --workspace @wvst/web-examples run serve:effect
scripts.example:web:instrument: npm run build:web:examples && npm --workspace @wvst/web-examples run serve:instrument
scripts.smoke:bridge:web: cargo build -p wvst-bridge-server -p wvst-host-worker && npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/web run smoke:bridge
scripts.smoke:browser:web: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/web run smoke:browser
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run build --
scripts.docs:check: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run check
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:check && npm run docs:build && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run deploy
